scope: Retained reorg-guard persistence and immediate announcement/signing gate, actual native RocksDB and LocalStore, public key11; no live production state.
faults: after actual successful commitSync returning an ambiguous-outcome error
external guard callback fails before write
assertions: in-memory halt and announcement atomic signal set before failed guard persistence
uncertain commit visibility is insufficient: later retry performs another sync commit and readback
backend guard failure retains pending status
same DB reopen halted and no additional signer call
fault_hook: Compile-time test-only flags around actual Rocks guard commit; production has no commit override.
limits: A new guard cannot survive SIGKILL or permanent storage failure before any successful fsync. The retained process keeps signing halted and retries; post-drain shutdown reports unpersisted guards. Previously durable signed-history authentication remains required on reopen.
